cytoscape.min.js — vendored third-party library
================================================

Package : cytoscape
License : MIT
Upstream: https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js
Copyright (c) 2016-2024, The Cytoscape Consortium.

The full MIT license text is embedded in the banner comment at the top of
web/vendor/cytoscape.min.js (unmodified official build). This file records
provenance in the same format as marked.LICENSE.txt: the library is loaded
locally — never from a CDN — so Sherpa's graph UI works without internet
access (see docs/manual/offline-kit.md).
